record.item: Ultrasound Views: RUSH Protocol Scan Locations

management_steps.details: Evaluate 'the pump, the tank, and the pipes' in undifferentiated shock. Scan locations: (1) Heart: PSLA/PSSA, Apical 4-chamber. (2) IVC: subcostal. (3) Morison's: RUQ, LUQ, suprapubic (FAST exam). (4) Aorta: abdominal slide view. (5) Pulmonary: Right/Left anterior chest (check lung sliding).

Cardiogenic: poor contractility, plethoric IVC. Obstructive (Tamponade/PE): pericardial effusion with RA/RV collapse, dilated RV, plethoric IVC. Hypovolaemic: collapsing IVC, hyperdynamic heart, free fluid in Morison's pouch (ruptured ectopic/haemorrhage).
